instructions.purpose: Update existing scheduled reminders or autonomous tasks created by schedule-once or schedule-recurring. Use this tool when the user wants to change the time, recurrence, or reminder content of a reminder that already exists.

tool.name: update-cron-job
tool.description: Updates an existing one-time or recurring cron job by name. Omitted fields keep their existing values. Recurring reminders can update pattern. One-time reminders can update fireAt. Reminder content updates replace the existing reminder content.

usage_rules.rule: Use list-cron-jobs first when the existing reminder name or type is uncertain
When the delegated request identifies the job and the change, call this tool without asking for confirmation
Use pattern only for existing recurring reminders
Use fireAt only for existing one-time reminders
Provide fireAt as local wall-clock time in the configured timezone, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, with no Z or offset; the server resolves daylight saving time
Never set fireAt in the past
For a content-only update, send only name and the new content fields; omit pattern and fireAt
Omit every field that is not changing; never send the current time or a placeholder
When changing generated reminder content, provide reminderPromptData and reminderFallbackText together
Pass reminderPromptData as a serialized JSON string, not as a nested object
Use generated reminder content when the wording should differ on each firing; reminderText repeats unchanged
After a failed update, change the arguments according to the error before calling again; an identical retry ends the run
When changing direct reminder content, provide reminderText only
When changing autonomous task content, provide taskPrompt and taskFallbackText together
A supplied content mode replaces and clears the previous content mode
automations is the full ordered list of saved automation names: a supplied list replaces the current one, an empty list removes all automations, and omitting it keeps them
Before attaching or removing automations, dry-run the change with preview-cron-job and update only after the user confirms

automations can only stay with taskPrompt or with no content mode; switching a job with automations to reminderText or reminderPromptData fails unless the same call passes automations as an empty list, so pass it only when the user wants the automations removed
A job must keep content: removing all automations from a job without a content mode requires a new content mode in the same call
To turn a reminder or task into a job that only sends automation text, recreate it with schedule-once or schedule-recurring and overwrite true
Omit fields that should stay unchanged
Inform the user of the updated next fire time after successfully updating

example.context: User says: "Move my dentist reminder to tomorrow at 10"
example.reasoning: The existing one-time reminder keeps its content and only changes fireAt.

example.context: User says: "Change my water reminder to every day at 10 instead"
example.reasoning: The existing recurring reminder keeps its content and only changes pattern.

example.context: User says: "Change the text of my standup reminder to say prepare notes"
example.reasoning: The reminder schedule stays unchanged and the direct reminder content is replaced.

example.context: User confirmed the preview of adding the weather automation to the morning-briefing task
example.reasoning: The supplied list replaces the old one, so it keeps news-digest and adds weather.

example.context: User says: "Make my weekly plant reminder different and more creative every time"
example.reasoning: Fresh wording is generated at each firing, and the omitted pattern keeps the schedule unchanged.
